requirements.requirement: DCP-0 remains a non-production successor and does not alter D-018 or RC3 classifications.
Web owns Better Auth human identity/control-plane concerns and Data Platform receives only machine-verifier projection.
The projected contract specifies UUID mapping, event versioning, ordering, idempotency, replay, revocation, rotation, and fail-closed behavior.
Tower database planning is disabled and secret-reference-only, with no apply or project manifest mutation.
API-key provider selection remains conditional until project binding, portable verification, audit, rotation/revocation, runtime, and security fit are proven.
Pinned Better Auth 1.7.2 core and explicit organization-role configuration are disabled by default, server-only, database-backed, exact-origin protected, and do not enable API-key sessions.
Organization and project ownership plus every owner, admin, developer, and read-only analyst authorization edge is explicit and locally verified.
Create, list, rotate, revoke, malformed-input rejection, persistence, audit, outbox, metrics, errors, and retries preserve one-time plaintext and metadata-only redaction guarantees.

Lifecycle transactions use UUIDv7 identities, finite non-negative integer projection validation, monotonic per-organization policy versions, idempotency metadata, exact 24-hour overlap, and immediate revocation precedence.

requirements.section: Threat model, trust boundaries, and assumptions
requirements.requirement: Browser/server, server/PostgreSQL, provider, outbox/Data, Tower/Infisical, and telemetry trust boundaries are documented and fail closed.

Separate auth/control PostgreSQL schemas and least-privilege roles are represented by deterministic generate-only migrations whose auth surface is parity-checked against pinned Better Auth 1.7.2 getAuthTables, with no live apply.
ProjectionTransport remains disabled and no Data-compatible mapping, provider, transport, or network claim is made before an immutable accepted receipt.
